_comment: Timed narration for the PDF Poster intro/outro. `text` is the reference wording; `tts` is what gets sent to ElevenLabs (URLs spoken out, bPlugins hyphenated so it isn't read as one word). `window` is the on-screen slot the line must fit inside, in seconds — every window here was measured against a 150 wpm proxy, so the real voice has extra headroom.

intro.tone: friendly tutorial — warm, unhurried, a touch of lift on the product name
intro._note: The brand sting (0.00-3.65s) is deliberately silent — it is a visual identity beat, and narrating it would push the topic line past the card that illustrates it. One line per card after that.

segments.on_screen: Topic card: "Display a PDF with a watermark, efficiently" beside the document page, with the CONFIDENTIAL wash fading in at 5.15s
segments.text: Learn how to display a PDF with a watermark, efficiently, with PDF Poster by bPlugins.
segments.tts: Learn how to display a PDF with a watermark, efficiently, with PDF Poster by b-Plugins.

segments.on_screen: Prerequisites card: three green checks and the mock WordPress plugin row showing Active / Up to date
segments.text: Make sure you have installed and activated the latest version of the PDF Poster plugin.
segments.tts: Make sure you have installed and activated the latest version of the PDF Poster plugin.

intro-analytics.tone: friendly tutorial — warm, unhurried, a touch of lift on the product name
intro-analytics._note: Same three-scene skeleton as the watermark intro; only scene 2 differs. The brand sting stays silent.

segments.on_screen: Topic card: "Track PDF views and downloads" beside the Analytics dashboard — 3,323 views / 861 downloads, with both chart series drawing in from 4.9s
segments.text: Learn how to track your PDF views and downloads with PDF Poster by bPlugins.
segments.tts: Learn how to track your PDF views and downloads with PDF Poster by b-Plugins.

segments.on_screen: Prerequisites card: three green checks and the mock WordPress plugin row showing Active / Up to date
segments.text: Make sure you have installed and activated the latest version of the PDF Poster plugin.
segments.tts: Make sure you have installed and activated the latest version of the PDF Poster plugin.

outro.tone: friendly tutorial — warm sign-off, clear on the calls to action

segments.on_screen: "Thanks for watching" eyebrow and headline wiping in

segments.text: PDF Poster is free on WordPress.org.
segments.tts: PDF Poster is free on WordPress dot org.

segments.on_screen: Docs and support rows both visible
segments.text: Docs and support are at bplugins.com.
segments.tts: Docs and support are at b-Plugins dot com.

segments.on_screen: Subscribe slot pulsing, watch-next panels to its right
Static hold — brand bar and end-screen slots
segments.text: See you in the next one!
segments.tts: See you in the next one!
